title: ShiftTemplate - Data API
description: Represents a template for creating shifts. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

BackgroundColor.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BackgroundColor.description: Sets a background color when shifts are displayed in the UI. Use a 3- or 6-digit hexadecimal format, for example #FF00FF. Available in API version 54.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: Additional information about the shift like number of breaks or activities.

Duration.description: How long the shift lasts. The unit of measurement for this field is determined by ShiftTemplateDurationType.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the shift is active or inactive.

IsNonStandard.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsNonStandard.description: Indicates whether the shift is nonstandard, such as overtime or on-call shifts. The default value is false. Available in API version 54.0 and later.

JobProfileId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
JobProfileId.description: The Job Profile record. This field is optional. This is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the shift template was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the shift template was last viewed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The owner of the shift template. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

RecordsetFilterCriteriaId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RecordsetFilterCriteriaId.description: The ID of the recordset filter criteria selected for the shift template. Available in API version 53.0 and later. This is a relationship field.

ShiftTemplateDurationType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ShiftTemplateDurationType.description: The unit of measurement for the shift template duration. Possible values are: H—Hours M—Minutes The default value is H.

StartTime.description: The time of day when the shift starts.

TimeSlotType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TimeSlotType.description: The type of time slot. Possible values are: Normal Extended You can use Extended to represent overtime shifts. Available in API version 55.0 and later.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ShiftTemplateOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ShiftTemplateShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
- **ShiftTemplateChangeEvent**: Change Data Capture events are available for the object. Available in API version 54.0 and later.
